brief.headline: Push for ₹28,644 saving on the PET bottle (16.6% gap vs our best price) — you're tiny (0.02% of their sales) but they're in the grey zone and cash-tight, so bundle volume or commit longer to get traction.

priceAsk.summary: Cut the PET BOT AMBER 100ML price from ₹2.18/NOS to ₹1.87/NOS — the price we already pay Suraj Blow Plast
priceAsk.basis: We're paying 16.6% more than our best price. Their market-ask verdict says typical PP caps run ₹0.85–0.95/pc with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at volume, so there's room. Close the gap to match Suraj.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days after receipt to 15 days after receipt in exchange for the price cut — paying 15 days faster is worth roughly their borrowing rate (10.27%)
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Costs us ₹46,539 in cash (half our yearly spend with them tied up 15 days earlier), but buys leverage since they borrow at 10.27% — early payment is valuable to them

brief.financialLeverage: They're rated [ICRA] A / Stable and made ₹637.48 Cr last year, so they won't fold. But their Altman Z is 2.77 (grey zone — not safe, not distress) and cash sits for 79 days vs peer 79d, so tight but not desperate. You're 0.02% of their sales (₹11.32 L) — microscopic — so alone you have almost no pull. They keep about ₹4 of every ₹100 they sell (3.8% margin), so a big price cut hurts them. Play it smart: offer faster payment (worth 10.27% to them) to justify the price move, and name Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a credible second source to show you can walk if they won't budge.

evidence.point: We pay ₹2.18/NOS for the 100ml PET bottle; our best price elsewhere is ₹1.87/NOS — a 16.6% gap
Closing that gap saves us ₹28,644 a year
They made ₹637.48 Cr revenue; we spend ₹11.32 L — just 0.02% of their business
They borrow at about 10.27%, so paying 15 days early is worth that rate to them
Their Altman Z score is 2.77 (grey zone) — not in trouble but not comfortably safe either
Credit rating is [ICRA] A / Stable, but they have GST filing delays and EPF payment delays on record
evidence.figure: creditRating: [ICRA] A / Stable; riskFlags: GST filing delays, EPF payment delays

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic converter (₹2569.83 Cr, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms — a strong, proven second source for our packaging

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr, health B 73/100) doing pails, containers, pharma — credible backup for bottles and closures

risks: You're 0.02% of their sales — too small to command attention on your own; bundle more SKUs, commit a longer term, or explicitly shop Manjushree to get leverage
Grey-zone Altman Z (2.77) plus GST and EPF delays mean some stress under the surface — push on price but don't squeeze so hard you force them into real trouble and lose supply
If they won't move on the PET bottle price, the ₹28,644 saving evaporates and paying 15 days early just costs us ₹46,539 cash for nothing — tie payment and price together in one offer
Market-ask verdict says typical caps have 'modest headroom at higher volume' — so volume commitment may be the key to unlock the price cut; come ready to commit quantity
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the 16.6% gap on the PET bottle to match our ₹1.87 price at Suraj — and we're willing to pay you 15 days faster to help your cash flow in return.
